fearGreed.read: CNN page had no score. Idéal Investisseur (SENTIMENT cnn_fg_stocks) prints 55.17 as of Fri 21 Aug 17:35 close — Neutral on the usual 45–55 band. Adanos reprints CNN as 55 and tags it Greed; Benzinga had Thu 20 Aug at 52.5 Neutral.

nbis.headline: Griffin Friday letter: Citadel unwound >80% of Situational Awareness risk via 100+ blocks >$4B
nbis.why: CNBC confirmed the letter. A Stocktwits recap on TradingView lists NBIS among SA’s top five disclosed names (with SNDK, MU, BE, TSM) and says most of those, except TSM, finished Friday lower. Citadel did not name which stocks were in the blocks — do not treat NBIS as a confirmed Citadel print.

nbis.headline: Company still expects $5.0B converts and the old-note exchange to settle Mon 24 Aug
nbis.why: Not a new pricing story — the next hard calendar date. IR/SEC exhibit: $3.0B 0.50% 2030 + $2.0B 4.50% 2034, greenshoe up to $450M / $300M; exchange on or about 24 Aug, not contingent on the new notes.

macro.headline: Seoul Friday: chips lift KOSPI; won firmer vs USD
macro.why: Yonhap: KOSPI +0.88% to 6,912.95; SK hynix +2.31%, Samsung +3.87% on shareholder-return hopes; foreign+retail net sellers ₩1.34T combined. Won 1,386.5, +6.1. Korea semis still bid while US memory/NBIS digested supply.

soWhat: NBIS Fri $219.13 (−0.45%) is a quiet session after the convert week; Yahoo cap $55.637B / GF $59.57B. Next hard date is Mon 24 Aug settle for the $5.0B notes and the old-note share exchange — not a new deal, just the cash/share print.

Citadel’s Friday letter is real (CNBC: >80% SA risk off, 100+ blocks, >$4B). Recaps list NBIS among SA’s old top names; Griffin did not disclose the block list. Treat any “Citadel sold NBIS Friday” line as unverified.
AI-infra week is NVDA-centric: Fri $214.72, Cloverleaf minority stake (terms not in the PR), print Wed 26 Aug after the close. Street on GF is $92.07B / $2.09 vs company $91.0B ±2% guide (Fool).

Memory split: SK hynix Fri ₩1,730,000 (+2.31%) and KOSPI +0.88% vs MU $966.78 (−0.77%). Macro ceiling is still the long end (10y 4.73%, 30y near a 2007 high). Fear & Greed last reprint 55.17 Neutral Friday. Jackson Hole 27–29 Aug.
